blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Mechanistic interpretability of vision transformers seeks to decompose model computation into human-readable
units, but learned representations entangle many concepts in each neuron. Feature superposition is
widely treated as the central obstacle to this decomposition, yet most mitigations (sparse autoencoders, dictionary
learning) are post-hoc and leave the underlying network unchanged. We ask whether a spatial-locality
training loss (TopoLoss) can act as a lightweight, training-time prior that improves interpretability
of standard mech-interp tools. Training ViT on ImageNet-100 across multiple TopoLoss weights α \alpha ,
we measure causal sufficiency of topographic clusters via activation patching and feature geometry via sparse
autoencoders fit to the same residual stream. At α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 , topographic clusters are
2.79 × \times more causally sufficient than random unit sets of the same size, with the effect increasing monotonically in α \alpha . SAE L0
sparsity decreases by 11% and dead-feature fraction rises 19-fold, yet standard neuron-level
monosemanticity scores are unchanged, indicating that topographic pressure acts at circuit level, concentrating causal mass into spatially local structures without disentangling individual neurons.
This dissociation suggests current neuron-level monosemanticity metrics
are insensitive to a class of real interpretability gains, and positions cheap architectural priors as a
viable training-time complement to post-hoc tooling.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The superposition hypothesis ( Elhage et al., 2022 ) posits that
neural networks represent more features than they have neurons, encoding
multiple unrelated concepts in each unit through approximate orthogonality
in high-dimensional space.
Superposition makes circuit analysis and in general, mechanistic analysis hard: patching a single neuron
contaminates unrelated features, and sparse autoencoders (SAEs) must
expend capacity to decompose polysemantic units into monosemantic
directions ( Bricken et al., 2023 ; Cunningham et al., 2023 ) .
Current solutions are almost entirely post-hoc where they learn to
decode a fixed representation rather than encouraging the model to form
a cleaner one.
blocks.zh:
叠位假说(Elhage等人,2022年)假定:
神经网络的特征比神经元 编码
通过近似正交,每个单元中多个无关的概念
在高维空间。
超位使电路分析以及一般的机械分析变得硬:补丁单个神经元
污染了不相关的特性,而稀疏的自动编码器必须
消耗将多语种单元分解为单语种的能力
方向(Bricken等人,2023年;Cunningham等人,2023年).
目前的解决办法几乎完全是在他们学习的地方
解码固定代表,而不是鼓励模型形成
一个清洁的。

blocks.en:
A complementary strategy is to impose an inductive bias during training
that couples nearby neurons, hoping spatial locality produces a form of functional organisation analogous to cortical maps in biological
vision ( Khosla et al., 2025 ) . Khosla et al. recently showed that a Laplacian weight-smoothness
penalty (TopoLoss) applied to vision and language transformers improves
brain-similarity scores without sacrificing accuracy.
The key open question is whether this reorganisation also improves mechanistic interpretability metrics .

希望空间定位能产生一种 类似于生物皮质图的功能组织
(Khosla等人,2025年). Khosla等人最近表明,拉普拉西亚人体重偏轻。
适用于视觉和语言变换器的处罚(TopoLoss)得到改善

关键的问题在于这种重组是否也改进了机械解释性指标。

blocks.en:
We conduct a systematic audit of TopoLoss across three interpretability axes: • H1 (monosemanticity): Do individual neurons become more
selective? Measured via entropy-based selectivity M u M_{u} . • H2 (superposition): Does the SAE-measured feature complexity
decrease? Measured via L0 norm and dead-feature fraction. • H3 (causal purity): Are topographic clusters more causally
sufficient for class prediction than random unit sets?
Measured via activation-patching logit-delta ratios.

通过激活-射标对数-德尔塔比率测量。

Our main findings are: H3 is strongly supported (p < < 0.0001, d = 0.95 d=0.95 );
H2 is supported at high α \alpha with a confound of accuracy;
H1 is null.
We further observe that H3 effects are more modest in a smaller
4-layer architecture (TinyViT), consistent with a scale or depth
requirement for circuit formation, though additional experiments
are needed to isolate this factor.

blocks.en:
Following Khosla et al. (2025) , we add a weight-smoothness penalty
to the standard cross-entropy loss: ℒ = ℒ CE + ℒ topo , ℒ topo = α ​ ∑ ( i , j ) ∈ ℰ ‖ w i − w j ‖ 2 , \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CE}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{topo}},\qquad\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{topo}}=\alpha\!\!\sum_{(i,j)\in\mathcal{E}}\|w_{i}-w_{j}\|^{2}, (1) where ℰ \mathcal{E} is the set of adjacent unit pairs on a fixed 2D
topographic grid and α ≥ 0 \alpha\geq 0 controls pressure strength.
In our ViT-S implementation, TopoLoss is applied to the attention-projection
weights ( attn.proj ) of all 12 blocks; units are arranged on a d × d \sqrt{d}\times\sqrt{d} grid matching the head dimension.

blocks.en:
We train ViT-S/16 ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) on
ImageNet-100 ( Deng et al., 2009 ) (126,688 train / 5,000 val,
100 classes) for α ∈ { 0.0 , 0.1 , 1.0 } \alpha\in\{0.0,0.1,1.0\} , with three seeds { 42,123,456 } \{42,123,456\} each, total of nine checkpoints.
A broader α \alpha -sweep ( α ∈ { 0 , 0.01 , 0.1 , 1.0 } \alpha\in\{0,0.01,0.1,1.0\} , seed 42)
provides dose-response curves.
We additionally train a lightweight TinyViT (4 layers, d = 128 d=128 , 4 heads)

All runs use AdamW, cosine schedule, and standard augmentation;
full hyperparameters are in Appendix A .

blocks.en:
H1 : Monosemanticity M u M_{u} is the normalised negative entropy of
a neuron’s class-activation distribution over 5,000 validation images, M u = ( H max − H ) / H max M_{u}=(H_{\max}-H)/H_{\max} , so M u = 1 M_{u}=1 is perfectly selective.
We also train an SAE (TopK, k = 32 k=32 , 2048 features) on layer-6 residuals
and measure per-feature selectivity.

Mu = (H max – H ) / H max M_{(H_{\max) / H_{\max ) ,所以 Mu = 1 M_{u}=1 的类活性分布是完全有选择性的。
我们还在6层残基上培训一个SAE(TopK,k = 32 k = 32,2048个特征)
并衡量每个地貌的选择性。

blocks.en:
H2 : SAE L0 sparsity. We train one SAE per checkpoint at layer 6 ( attn.proj output)
and report the mean number of active features per token (L0) and the
fraction of dead features (active on < < 0.1% of tokens).
Lower L0 and higher dead-feature fraction indicate sparser, more
specialised representations. The choice of layer 6 was motivated by it lying in the middle of the effect band (Appendix E )

并报告每个符号(L0)和
死亡特征(活动于 < 0.1%)。
低L0和高死因分数 表示稀疏,更多
专门陈述。 选择第6层的动机是它躺在效果带(Appendix E)的中间.

blocks.en:
H3 : Causal purity. For each of 20 randomly selected ImageNet-100 classes and each of the
3 seeds, we identify the top- k = 16 k=16 neurons most activated by that class,
compute the mean absolute logit delta when patching this cluster
from a source (target-class image) into a target (other-class image),
and normalise by the delta from patching a random size- k k set.
Ratios > 1 >1 mean topographic clusters carry disproportionate causal weight.
The top- k k selection rule is by activation magnitude and does not enforce spatial contiguity;
we verify post-hoc (Table 2 ) that these sets are nonetheless spatially co-localised
under TopoLoss, justifying the cluster framing.

3个种子,我们确定最高的 -k = 16 k = 16个神经元 最受该类激活,
修补此集群时计算平均绝对数三角洲
从源(目标类图像)到目标(其他类图像),
并让三角洲从随机大小- k k 设置中正常化 。
比率 > 1 > 1 平均地形群带不成比例的因果权重。
最高- k k 选择规则是按激活量进行,不执行空间毗连;
我们核实Hoc后(表2),这些组合在空间上共同定位
在TopoLoss下,说明集群框架的理由。

blocks.en: 3.2 H2: Reduced Feature Superposition
blocks.zh: 3.2 H2: 降低特性超位

blocks.en:
At α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 , SAE L0 decreases by 11 % 11\% relative to baseline
( 1133.8 ± 3.2 1133.8\pm 3.2 vs 1273.9 ± 15.0 1273.9\pm 15.0 ; p = 0.007 p=0.007 , d = 7.06 d=7.06 ) and the
dead-feature fraction rises 19-fold ( 3.8 ± 0.8 % 3.8\pm 0.8\% vs 0.2 ± 0.1 % 0.2\pm 0.1\% ).
The α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 model shows neither effect reliably ( p = 0.054 p=0.054 for L0, p = 0.580 p=0.580 for dead fraction), confirming a threshold between α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 and α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 .
The L0 reduction is distributed across depth (layers 3–10, peak at
layer 10; see Appendix E ), not localised to a single block.

We treat the L0 reduction as suggestive but not confound-free.
The α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 model suffers a − 1.6 -1.6 pp accuracy cost
( 61.2 % → 59.6 % 61.2\%\to 59.6\% ), and an OLS regression of L0 on validation
accuracy across all 9 ViT-S checkpoints yields R 2 = 0.72 R^{2}=0.72 ( p = 0.004 p=0.004 ),
indicating accuracy explains substantial L0 variance.
Two analyses suggest the effect is not entirely accuracy-driven.
First, the PCA d 95 d_{95} dissociation at α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 , where SAE L0 increases ( + 32.5 +32.5 ) while d 95 d_{95} decreases ( − 8.3 -8.3 ),
shows SAE L0 captures structure beyond raw effective dimensionality.
Second, two of three α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 seeds lie below the accuracy-L0
regression line (sparser than accuracy alone predicts).
An accuracy-matched ablation would directly resolve the confound
and is left for future work.

blocks.en:
As a preliminary probe, we trained TinyViT (4-layer, d = 128 d=128 ) with the
same protocol.
The H2 trend replicates: L0 decreases monotonically with α \alpha ( − 2.1 -2.1 %
at α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 ), consistent with the weight-norm scaling rule α eff = α ⋅ ( rms ref / rms tgt ) 2 \alpha_{\mathrm{eff}}=\alpha\cdot(\mathrm{rms}_{\mathrm{ref}}/\mathrm{rms}_{\mathrm{tgt}})^{2} (see Appendix F ).
H3, however, saturates: the maximum ratio across all α \alpha is 1.42 × 1.42\times ( α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 ), far below the ViT-S result of 2.79 × 2.79\times .
We caution that TinyViT and ViT-S differ simultaneously in depth, width,
accuracy, and training budget; with a single seed per α \alpha we cannot
isolate the responsible factor.
Depth is one plausible hypothesis as a 4-layer network may lack sufficient
representational stages for topographic pressure to form coherent causal
circuits, but this requires a controlled depth-sweep to confirm.
We treat the TinyViT result as a useful negative: the simple weight-norm
calibration rule predicts H2 transfer (which we observe) but not H3
transfer (which we do not), suggesting H3 depends on architectural factors
beyond effective topographic pressure.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Monosemanticity ( M u M_{u} ) measures the distribution of a single neuron over
classes, a marginal statistic insensitive to the joint arrangement
of multiple neurons.
Activation patching measures whether a specific set of neurons is jointly
sufficient for a prediction, a multivariate, circuit-level probe.
Our results suggest that TopoLoss reorganises neurons into functionally
coherent spatial clusters (H3) without changing how selectivity is spread
across individual neurons (H1).
This is consistent with Elhage et al. (2022) : superposition
redistributes information across neurons, so spatial co-location (not
per-neuron selectivity) is the relevant unit of circuit purity.

每个中微子选择性)是电路纯度的相关单位.

blocks.en:
Standard mech-interp interventions are post-hoc: SAEs learn to decode
a representation after training; patching reveals circuits but does not
change them.
Our results show that a < < 0.1k-parameter regularisation term, added to
the training loss, systematically shifts circuit geometry in a way
measurable by existing tools.
The effect is modest in cost ( − 1.6 -1.6 pp accuracy at α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 ) and
strong in signal ( d = 0.95 d=0.95 for H3).

培训后显示; 补丁显示线路,但不显示
改变它们。
我们的结果显示,一个 < 0.1k-参数正规化术语添加到
训练损失,以某种方式系统转换电路几何
由现有工具计量。
其影响不大(α=1.0\alpha=1.0)和
信号强烈(d=0.95 d=0.95 for H3).

blocks.en:
Khosla et al. (2025) demonstrated that TopoLoss improves brain
similarity without accuracy loss; we evaluate it on mechanistic
interpretability axes for the first time. Bricken et al. (2023) and Cunningham et al. (2023) use SAEs
as diagnostic tools; we show that TopoLoss shifts the SAE’s diagnosis. Conmy et al. (2023) use activation patching to localise circuits within
a single model; we use the same protocol to compare models trained
with different priors.
Topographic constraints in deep networks have a longer lineage ( Lee et al., 2020 ; Doshi and Konkle, 2023 ; Margalit et al., 2024 ) ; we focus on TopoLoss as a
recent, lightweight instantiation amenable to standard mech-interp tooling.
Work on topographic self-organisation in networks
( Zeiler and Fergus, 2014 ; Olah et al., 2020 ) has noted
functional clustering informally; we quantify it with controlled patching
experiments.

我们显示TopoLoss改变了SAE的诊断。 Conmy等人(2023年)使用激活补丁在内部本地化电路

最近,轻量级即时化 适合标准的 mech-interp 工具。

blocks.en: Impact Statement
blocks.zh: 影响说明

blocks.en:
This paper presents work whose goal is to advance the field of mechanistic
interpretability by studying training-time interventions that reduce feature
superposition.
Improved interpretability tools may help identify and mitigate harmful
capabilities in AI systems.
There are no direct negative societal consequences we foresee from this
methodological contribution.
blocks.zh:
本文件介绍旨在推进机械化领域的工作。
通过研究减少特征的培训时间干预措施进行解释
叠位.
改进可解释性工具可能有助于查明和减轻有害因素。
人工智能系统的能力。
我们没有预见到任何直接的负面社会后果
方法贡献。
